a-hitmans-guide-to-becoming-a-hero:
In his previous life, he was a hitman. Precise, calculated, unbothered by morality. He didn't save people.
He removed them.
Then he died, and woke up somewhere he never asked to be — a world where a mysterious plague turns ordinary people into monsters or miracles, and the line between hero and villain is thinner than anyone admits.
Now he has two sisters depending on him, an ability he didn't ask for, and an entire Hero Association desperate to have him on their side, thanks to his unique abilities.
With the Hero Association convinced he's one of them, Nicholas is more than willing to let them keep their assumption.

He was no Hero!

[Ding!]

[Talent Awakened.]
[Talent Name: Dragon Genesis]
[Talent Rank: SSS Rank]
